items.question: “Customers have to call us for every update.”

items.question: “We have a product idea. But no development team.”

legalInfo.title: Legal Information
legalInfo.description: Business identification and contact details for PlainlySmart.

legal.title: Privacy Policy
legal.description: How PlainlySmart handles inquiries, personal data and website storage.
legal.draft: Draft — complete controller details and legal decisions before publication.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: The controller operates under the PlainlySmart brand. Its identity and privacy contact details appear below. Missing identity details must be supplied before publication.

sections.title: Information collected
sections.body: The form collects name, email, message, optional phone, language and optional newsletter choice. The API also accepts an optional company name. With separate attribution permission, campaign parameters accompany your inquiry. Please do not send sensitive personal data.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
sections.body: Inquiry handling may rely on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR for steps you request before a contract, or Article 6(1)(f) for other correspondence. Security may rely on legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f). The controller must confirm these bases and assess its interests. Optional newsletters rely on separate consent under Article 6(1)(a), which you can withdraw by contacting us without affecting earlier lawful processing. Campaign attribution requires separate optional permission. Neither choice is required to contact us.

sections.title: Technical information and security
sections.body: Hosting and security providers may process IP addresses, browser/device information and request metadata. Cloudflare Turnstile runs when the form is opened to prevent automated abuse; the backend verifies its token. Application logs contain request identifiers and outcomes, without intentionally recording contact content, email addresses, phone numbers or tokens.

sections.title: Recipients and providers
sections.body: Data passes through AWS API Gateway and Lambda to Brevo. Brevo stores the contact, sends an internal notification to our inbox and sends you a confirmation. Cloudflare provides Turnstile. Hosting and mailbox providers also handle technical data or correspondence. Contracting entities, processor/controller roles and agreements require verification. This workflow does not use automated decision-making with legal or similarly significant effects.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.body: Providers may process data outside the EEA. Destinations and applicable safeguards, such as an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses with necessary supplementary measures, must be verified against contracts and account settings. EU-only processing is not guaranteed. Contact us for details of applicable safeguards.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Infrastructure configures function and API logs for 30 days. Retention periods or specific deletion criteria for Brevo contacts, inbox copies, provider logs, backups and newsletter records have not yet been approved. The controller must decide and publish them before finalizing this policy. Data should only be kept as needed for its stated purpose and applicable obligations.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under GDPR conditions you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction and portability, object to processing based on legitimate interests, and withdraw consent at any time. Write to the privacy contact below. Proportionate identity verification may be needed. Responses are normally due within one month; lawful extensions must be explained.

sections.title: Complaints
sections.body: You can complain to the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ), linked below, or another competent supervisory authority.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: The application sets no first-party cookies. localStorage remembers your requested theme (theme), language (preferredLocale) and attribution choice (plainlysmart.attribution-consent.v1) until changed or cleared. Only with acceptance, sessionStorage stores campaign parameters (plainlysmart.utm) for the tab session. Withdrawal clears attribution and stops attaching it to future inquiries. No analytics library, advertising pixel or third-party media embed was found in the source audit. Turnstile processes technical security signals; see its provider notice below. Hosting cookies and Turnstile configuration require deployment verification. Change attribution preferences in the footer or clear browser storage.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: Updates are published here with a revised date. Material changes may need additional notice or renewed consent. This policy remains a draft until identity details and legal decisions are completed.

consent.title: Campaign attribution
consent.body: May we store campaign parameters for this session and attach them to your inquiry? Your choice does not affect the contact form.
